import copy, json; from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol); assert got==expected,(got,expected); assert (req,ev,pol)==before; assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'z':1,'a':'x'}}; pol={'required_conditions':['z','a'],'require_verified':True}
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],pol,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
check(base,[],pol,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':False}],pol,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(base,[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True}],pol,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['b'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':2},'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True}],pol,{'status':'supported','value':{'b':2,'a':1},'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True}],pol,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed')
